// diagnostic

E0761

Unknown `#Context` field or context key: a `#Context` label or `context.get` argument names neither `allocator`, `logger` nor a `#ContextKey` constant, or a `#ContextKey` reuses a context field name or is mutable

What

Unknown `#Context` field or context key: a `#Context` label or `context.get` argument names neither `allocator`, `logger` nor a `#ContextKey` constant, or a `#ContextKey` reuses a context field name or is mutable

Why

The context bundle holds `allocator` and `logger`, plus the values a package declares with `#ContextKey`

Fix

Use a context field or declare the key: `#ContextKey frame_index: 0`, then `#Context(frame_index: 3)` and `context.get(frame_index)`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0761: tests/ui/context_get_not_key.stderr.

Error [jet.UnknownContextField]: `context.get` needs a context key
  --> tests/ui/context_get_not_key.jet:5:20
    |
  5 |     _: context.get(LIMIT)
    |                    ^^^^^
 Why: Only a constant declared with `#ContextKey` names a context value
 Fix: Declare a snake_case key such as `#ContextKey frame_index: 0` and pass its name
